purpose: Teach: 多かれ/暮し/所々/苛立ち/うかがえる/真中/縮め/探し出し

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、人は多かれ少なかれ悩みがあるのよ
lines.en: Sho, people all carry worries of one kind or another, you know.
lines.style: Gentle, knowing tone. Speaking from experience, not lecturing. Soft opening, steady pace. Like she's sharing something she's learned to accept.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんとの暮しが幸せだよ
lines.en: Mom, being here with you and Dad makes me happy.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. No performance. The words come simply, the way a child states something he knows to be true. Meets her eyes, unhurried.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お家の壁が所々剥がれてきたわね
lines.en: Sho, the walls in our house are starting to peel in places.
lines.style: Observant, almost to herself. Not complaining—noticing. Slight sadness underneath. The tone of someone cataloguing what she sees but not quite saying why it matters.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが疲れて苛立ちを抑えてらしたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad's been tired. I can see him holding back his frustration.
lines.style: Quiet, steady recognition. Not distressed—factual. The perception of a child who watches carefully and understands more than adults expect. Soft, clear.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんのお顔から疲れがうかがえるわ
lines.en: Sho, you can see the exhaustion in your father's face.
lines.style: Reflective, almost to herself. The acceptance of something she's noticed and carries. Slow pace, gentle weight. Not asking for agreement, just acknowledging what is.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お部屋の真中で本を読んでるよ
lines.en: Mom, I've been sitting in the middle of my room reading.
lines.style: Bright turn, but still grounded. The eagerness is genuine but not loud. A small offering—look, I'm here, I'm okay, safe in my own space. Light lift at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ズボンの裾を縮めて直しましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's take in the hem of your pants for you.
lines.style: Practical, warm. A mother's gentle direction. Matter-of-fact but tender—this is what she does. No fuss, just care. Opening clear, pace steady.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、なくしたおもちゃを探し出したよ
lines.en: Mom, I found the toy I lost.
lines.style: Genuine bright lift. Pride without boasting. A small victory he wants to share. The eagerness is warm and open—he's coming closer to tell her something good.
